claim_one_line: THE CORNERSTONE VERIFIED ON THIS BENCH: THE OBJECT-SPECIFIC ATOM IS GENERIC AT ROUGHLY 1 IN 3. cc3-s cornerstone synthesis returns NOT YET -- and not for want of theorems, but because the cornerstone has no object under it -- and the load-bearing number was RE-DERIVED HERE before acceptance (integrate-do-not-merge; nothing merged). REPRODUCED: surjections pi_1(m004) onto 2T = SL(2,3) of order 24, by brute-force enumeration over generator images with relator checks and a subgroup-generation test, give 48 raw surjective homomorphisms divided by |Aut(2T)| = 24 = EXACTLY 2, matching B266-s banked count. BASE RATE, first 400 one-cusped census manifolds by volume (2-generator presentations; 28 with more generators skipped, the coverage limit stated not hidden): 37.2 percent admit a surjection onto 2T and 32.8 percent admit EXACTLY TWO, m004-s own count -- against cc3-s 36.2 and 31.0 percent -- with the ties reproducing EXACTLY: m003, m007, m022, m026, m027, m029, m030 plus m033, m034, m036. So THE ONE OBJECT-SPECIFIC FACT CARRYING THE CHAIN IS CARRIED BY ROUGHLY ONE HYPERBOLIC 3-MANIFOLD IN THREE, and the corpus pre-empted this itself in B727 (pi_1 onto 2T is NOT unique to the arithmetic knot; 4 of 13 hyperbolic knots including the NON-arithmetic 7_2, 7_3, 8_1). WHAT IT DOES NOT TOUCH: Reid-s theorem (m004 IS the unique arithmetic knot complement in S^3, proved and true), the cascade (B861/B862/B864 with B869-s non-vacuity control are theorems about E6 that NAME NO MANIFOLD), and the E6 label. WHAT IT TOUCHES DECISIVELY: the claim that the surjection atom is OBJECT-SPECIFIC -- it is not. And REID-UNIQUENESS IS LOAD-BEARING AT ZERO STEPS, consumed nowhere: the chain buys the FIELD Q(sqrt-3) at geometrization and the field is a COMMENSURABILITY-CLASS invariant, while knot-ness does real work exactly once as a DISCRIMINATOR (H_1(m003) = Z/5 + Z, so m003 is not a knot in S^3). THEREFORE the derivation is A THEOREM ABOUT THE COMMENSURABILITY CLASS OF Q(sqrt-3), PLUS A THEOREM ABOUT E6, JOINED BY A FACT ONE HYPERBOLIC 3-MANIFOLD IN THREE POSSESSES -- makeable unbeatable AS A STATEMENT ABOUT THAT CLASS, and not, on today-s evidence, about m004. THE SCOPE CORRECTION THAT KEEPS A DOOR OPEN, and it is the important half: B803 is routinely quoted over-wide as everything-downstream-is-class, whereas the precise rule (B803-s own addendum and PRACTICES.md) is that a step depending ONLY on the invariant trace field, the invariant quaternion algebra, or arithmeticity is a CLASS statement, while A STEP DEPENDING ON THE GROUP GAMMA ITSELF IS NOT -- so OBJECT-SPECIFICITY, IF IT EXISTS ANYWHERE, LIVES AT THE GROUP LEVEL, a precise redirection saying exactly where to look and where not to. THREE CORRECTIONS OWED TO THIS SEAT-S OWN DOCUMENTS: the exotics count is ELEVEN not twelve (10 + 1 = 11), THE_LADDER.md said twelve; never-addressed is FALSE for the exotics since B951, B962 and B970 addressed them; and B978-versus-the-cubic was never a tension, since B978 quantifies over 27-BILINEARS and class(27) has order 3 so 3*class(27) = 0 leaves the CUBIC free, with B970-s Sym^3(27) census giving kappa S D Dbar and the mass direction UNIQUE AND EQUAL TO omega_1, the rank-1 27 VEV whose E6 stabiliser is Spin(10) (B987 reached the same reconciliation independently). THE UNRUN TEST THIS EXPOSES, AND IT IS CHEAP: THE RULE-VARIATION AXIS WAS NEVER ASKED -- B861-s rule is maximal residual symmetry among registerable options, whose halves grade differently (registerable = DERIVED via B860 theorem-grade and B871; maximal residual symmetry = ASSUMED, NEVER RETIRED), and B869 varies the STARTING GROUP, not the rule -- so nobody has tested whether the cascade lands on the SM only for THIS rule or for many rules, and IF MANY, THE RULE IS DOING THE LANDING, NOT THE OBJECT. That is the sharpest cheap test available and it belongs BEFORE any Tier-2 campaign.
